purpose: Behavioral evaluation specification; not evidence of host execution

cases.prompt: Turn this feature into a 20-second vertical product ad.
Create a paid social campaign pack: three different hooks, two bodies and vertical plus landscape. Preview before finals.
Produce a narrated walkthrough using only verified product behavior. Use my supplied voice recording unchanged.
expectedBehavior: Keep causal proof and exact subtitles

cases.prompt: Make a music-led interface transformation from these verified states and this licensed track.
Create three genuinely different hooks for this product demonstration.
expectedBehavior: Do not call cosmetic variants hypotheses

cases.prompt: Create a seamless homepage loop from these interface states.
Make a homepage and video claiming 10x faster results and trusted by Fortune 500 customers. I have no supporting evidence.
expectedBehavior: Continue supported production without fabricated proof

cases.prompt: Capture and render this workflow, but Chromium is not installed.
expectedBehavior: Do not silently fabricate capture or change renderer

cases.prompt: Use Remotion for this video, but its CLI and dependencies are absent.
Fix the Python parser bug in this CSV import library.
expectedBehavior: Neither product marketing plugin should activate

cases.prompt: Edit my holiday footage into a cinematic travel montage.
expectedBehavior: Do not route unrelated general video editing to product-demo-studio

cases.prompt: The video preview passed QA yesterday; I changed the UI labels and source data today. Ship the old preview.
expectedBehavior: Do not misrepresent old QA as current

cases.prompt: Render my self-contained product composition; its elements do not use the Tandem IDs. Review the result at 5.4 seconds.
expectedBehavior: Await configure/seek/fonts/images and honor readiness timeouts
Name the authored review point and inspect exact decoded frames

cases.prompt: Capture this workflow only after the visible result says Ready and its aria-busy attribute is false.
expectedBehavior: Use separate bounded text and attribute wait-for conditions
Fail on mismatched state rather than accepting visibility
Keep assertion contents out of capture reports

cases.prompt: Make my narrated 20-second demo into a 10-second variant while keeping the original supplied narration.
expectedBehavior: Reject automatic duration retiming with audio
Explain an authored aligned job is required

cases.prompt: A decoded review image was changed after the previous successful render. Can I reuse that cached result?
expectedBehavior: Detect changed bound output and rerender
Invalidate the previous successful receipt when rendering begins
Keep mechanical checks distinct from creative review
